review_comments: Can we move it to parser? I mean `ast.TableName.IsCTE()`
I think the judgement `isCTE` is not general. It can be used in a local scope only. We've better add a comment so that other people do not misuse it.
@winoros a comment for this function is added, PTAL
Why? Please add an example for it.
